subject: SVOM GRB261113.60: Global MASTER-Net observations report
body:

MASTER-Tunka robotic telescope  [1]  located in Russia (Applied Physics Institute, Irkutsk State University) was pointed to the SVOM GRB261113.60 (trigger No 1794580260,23h 05m 17.23s , +05d 08m 36.2s, R=0.0403) errorbox  13 sec after notice time and 74 sec after trigger time at 2026-11-13 14:32:14 UT, with upper limit up to  18.3 mag. The observations began at zenith distance = 52 deg. The sun  altitude  is -46.6 deg. 

The galactic latitude b = -49 deg., longitude l = 81 deg.


Real time updated cover map and OT discovered available here: 
https://master.sai.msu.ru/site/master2/observ.php?id=3532578

We obtain a following upper limits.  

Tmid-T0  |      Date Time      |          Site       |             Coord (J2000)          |Filt.| Expt. | Limit| Comment
_________|_____________________|_____________________|____________________________________|_____|_______|_______|________

      79 | 2026-11-13 14:32:14 |        MASTER-Tunka | (23h 03m 12.73s , +04d 46m 34.0s) |   C |    10 | 18.3 |        
Filter C is a clear (unfiltred) band. 


The observation and reduction will continue. 
The message may be cited.
